# Duality Labs

> Software engineering studio: custom software, mobile apps, AI integration, and machine learning. Miami, FL.

Duality Labs is a software engineering studio founded by Erich Alfonso and Alejandro Alfonso in Miami, Florida. We design and build custom software, mobile apps, AI integrations, and machine learning systems for businesses, from first prototype to production.

## Services

- Custom Software Development: Web applications, APIs, internal tools, admin dashboards, MVP development
- Mobile App Development: iOS and Android apps and the backends behind them
- AI Integration & Consulting: Custom AI agents, LLM integrations, RAG systems, AI strategy and implementation
- Machine Learning: Custom models, LLM fine-tuning, ML pipelines, production ML infrastructure
- Data Infrastructure & Automation: Data pipelines, workflow automation, system integrations, reporting and analytics

## Work

- Autonomous Meta Ads agent: bid management state machine, 300+ autonomous decisions in production
- NEMT operations platform: 11-module HIPAA-ready platform replacing spreadsheet-based operations
- Music asset pipeline: autonomous MP4 ingestion, deduplication, tempo stretch, Google Sheets logging
- Autonomous trading agent: Discord signal parsing, risk policy enforcement, Alpaca order execution
